# University of California, Berkeley
> UC Berkeley is a leading public research university offering academic programs, research, admissions information, campus services, and news.

UC Berkeley pushes the boundaries of knowledge, challenges convention, and expands opportunity through teaching, research, and public service. This guide highlights the university’s primary information resources for prospective students, current students, faculty, staff, families, alumni, and researchers.

## Main University
- [Home](https://www.berkeley.edu/): University homepage with access to academics, admissions, research, and campus resources.
- [About UC Berkeley](https://www.berkeley.edu/about/): Overview of the university’s mission, impact, and institutional profile.
- [By the Numbers](https://www.berkeley.edu/about/by-the-numbers/): Key statistics on enrollment, research, faculty, and campus impact.
- [History & Discoveries](https://www.berkeley.edu/about/history-discoveries/): Historical milestones and major discoveries associated with Berkeley.
- [Traditions](https://www.berkeley.edu/about/traditions/): Campus traditions, symbols, and longstanding Berkeley culture.
- [Map](https://www.berkeley.edu/map/): Campus map for buildings, landmarks, and visitor navigation.
- [Directory](https://www.berkeley.edu/directory/): Directory for finding people, departments, and campus contacts.

## Admissions & Financial Aid
- [Admissions and Financial Aid](https://www.berkeley.edu/): Primary entry point to undergraduate and graduate admissions information.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://admissions.berkeley.edu/): Application requirements, deadlines, and guidance for undergraduate applicants.
- [Financial Aid and Scholarships](https://financialaid.berkeley.edu/): Aid programs, scholarships, costs, and financial planning resources.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://grad.berkeley.edu/admissions/): Admissions requirements and application guidance for graduate programs.
- [International Office](https://internationaloffice.berkeley.edu/): Immigration, visa, and support information for international students.
- [Summer Sessions](https://summer.berkeley.edu/): Summer courses, visiting student options, and seasonal academic opportunities.

## Academics
- [Academics](https://www.berkeley.edu/): Overview of undergraduate and graduate academic offerings across the university.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://guide.berkeley.edu/undergraduate/): Berkeley Academic Guide for undergraduate majors, minors, and degree requirements.
- [Graduate Programs](https://grad.berkeley.edu/programs/list/): Directory of graduate degrees and academic programs.
- [Berkeley Academic Guide](https://guide.berkeley.edu/): Official catalog for courses, programs, and academic policies.
- [Schools and Colleges](https://www.berkeley.edu/academics/): Entry point to Berkeley’s schools, colleges, and academic divisions.
- [Class Schedule](https://classes.berkeley.edu/): Searchable schedule of classes, instructors, and course offerings.
- [Registrar](https://registrar.berkeley.edu/): Academic records, enrollment, calendars, and student registration services.

## Research
- [Research at Berkeley](https://www.berkeley.edu/research/): Overview of Berkeley research strengths, initiatives, and societal impact.
- [Office of the Vice Chancellor for Research](https://vcresearch.berkeley.edu/): Research administration, compliance, funding, and support services.
- [Research Units and Centers](https://vcresearch.berkeley.edu/research-unit-directory): Directory of organized research units and centers.
- [Library](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/): Research library system, collections, databases, and scholarly support.
- [Undergraduate Research](https://research.berkeley.edu/urap/): Undergraduate research opportunities and faculty-led project listings.
- [Innovation & Entrepreneurship](https://innovation.berkeley.edu/): Resources connecting research, startups, and entrepreneurial programs.

## Student Resources
- [Students](https://www.berkeley.edu/students/): Central hub for student services, academics, and campus life resources.
- [CalCentral](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/): Student portal for academics, finances, tasks, and campus updates.
- [Student Affairs](https://studentaffairs.berkeley.edu/): Support services, wellbeing, engagement, and student life programs.
- [Housing](https://housing.berkeley.edu/): On-campus housing options, applications, and residential life information.
- [Career Center](https://career.berkeley.edu/): Career advising, internships, job search tools, and employer connections.
- [University Health Services](https://uhs.berkeley.edu/): Medical, counseling, wellness, and public health services for students.
- [Basic Needs Center](https://basicneeds.berkeley.edu/): Food, housing, and financial security support resources.

## Faculty & Staff
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.berkeley.edu/faculty-staff/): Central hub for employment, services, and campus tools for employees.
- [Human Resources](https://hr.berkeley.edu/): Employment policies, benefits, payroll, and workplace resources.
- [Academic Personnel Office](https://apo.berkeley.edu/): Policies and support for faculty appointments, reviews, and advancement.
- [People & Culture](https://hr.berkeley.edu/): Workplace support, employee services, and organizational resources.
- [bConnected](https://bconnected.berkeley.edu/): Email, collaboration, and productivity tools for the Berkeley community.
- [Berkeley IT](https://technology.berkeley.edu/): Technology services, security guidance, and campus IT support.
- [Controller’s Office](https://controller.berkeley.edu/): Financial operations, reimbursements, and accounting guidance.

## Campus Life & Community
- [Visit Berkeley](https://visit.berkeley.edu/): Visitor information, tours, events, and planning resources.
- [Campus Life](https://studentaffairs.berkeley.edu/): Student organizations, activities, and community engagement resources.
- [Athletics](https://calbears.com/): Official Cal Athletics site with teams, schedules, and news.
- [Arts at Berkeley](https://arts.berkeley.edu/): Arts events, programs, venues, and creative opportunities on campus.
- [Public Events](https://events.berkeley.edu/): University events calendar for lectures, performances, and community activities.
- [Parking and Transportation](https://pt.berkeley.edu/): Parking permits, transit options, and commuting information.
- [University Health Services](https://uhs.berkeley.edu/): Health and wellness services supporting campus life.

## News & Communications
- [Berkeley News](https://news.berkeley.edu/): Official university news covering research, campus, and public impact.
- [News Center](https://news.berkeley.edu/): Articles, announcements, and feature stories from across Berkeley.
- [Media Relations](https://news.berkeley.edu/media-contacts/): Media contacts and press resources for journalists.
- [Berkeley Events](https://events.berkeley.edu/): Calendar of upcoming university events and public programs.
- [Berkeley Social Media Directory](https://www.berkeley.edu/social-media/): Official social media channels across the university.
- [Public Affairs](https://news.berkeley.edu/): Communications and storytelling about Berkeley’s work and impact.

## Alumni, Parents & Giving
- [Parents](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/): Information and support resources for families of Berkeley students.
- [Alumni](https://my.berkeley.edu/): Alumni community portal for programs, benefits, and engagement.
- [Berkeley Alumni Association](https://alumni.berkeley.edu/): Alumni events, chapters, networking, and lifelong connection opportunities.
- [Give to Berkeley](https://give.berkeley.edu/): Philanthropic giving opportunities supporting students, research, and programs.
- [Foundation and Development](https://give.berkeley.edu/): Giving priorities, campaigns, and donor information.
- [Parent and Family Programs](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/): Family engagement, orientation, and campus partnership resources.
